paragraphs: The son of R' Yose ben Chalafta; see the entry R' Menachem son of R' Yose.[^1]

notes.text: The source's abbreviated personal titles remain R': Yose ben Chalafta, Menachem, and the latter Yose. No exact named primary passage is supplied here to support full Rabbi expansions. The son relationship and the cross-reference are retained; the pointer does not itself bind Vardimas to Menachem or establish an authority identity. The original cross-reference note and all earlier English remain archived. The prior PASS_TEXTUAL is a historical model judgment, not automatic publication or identity admission.
